questions: who received network working group memos at mit
subtitle: A one-paragraph 1969 note saying where to mail Network Working Group memos at M.I.T.

tldr.problem: The M.I.T. site needed to start receiving Network Working Group memos.
tldr.mechanism: The note gives the mailing address for Abhai Bhushan at Project MAC and his phone number.
tldr.outcome: It obsoletes RFC 10 and was updated by RFC 24, RFC 27 and RFC 30.

sections.title: M.I.T. Joins the Mailing List
sections.content:
This one-paragraph note by Steve Crocker, dated 27 August 1969, says that M.I.T. is now to receive all Network Working Group memos.

Memos should be addressed to Abhai Bhushan at Room 807, Project MAC, 545 Technology Square, Cambridge, Mass. 02139.
sections.eli5: It tells people where to send copies of the group's papers for one school.

sections.title: Contact Details
sections.content: The note also gives Abhai's phone number, (617) 864-6900, extension 5857. There is no protocol here, only a distribution address.
sections.eli5: It also lists a phone number, like a name card.

sections.title: Place in the Series
sections.content: This RFC obsoletes RFC 10 per the unit metadata and was later updated by RFC 24, RFC 27 and RFC 30. The text itself ends with a note that it was restored to on-line status by Walter Pienciak.
sections.eli5: It replaces an older note and was itself touched up by newer ones.
